composition.elementLabel: Access Analyzer Reusable Logs Page for Viewport

value.message:
• [Passed] Access granted
  • [Blocked] Access denied
  • [Skipped] Did not evaluate
  • [Undefined] No rule found
Each rows represents an individual ACL. The sequence (#) shows the order in which ACL's are evaluated. The status shows whether overall access is granted (passed) or denied (blocked).
